assets.name: Blank Side Promise
assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit the first image only in its top-left branding margin. Paste the actual supplied SORA emblem graphic from image 2 as a LARGE flat printed white square label. Make the label occupy one fifth of the cover's total width, about 250 pixels on this canvas; the red circle inside should be about 180 pixels across. The actual supplied emblem has two equally long white horizontal bars, a central vertical connector, and two constant-width straight diagonal white cutouts which continue completely through the lower red circumference. Copy that exact geometry from image 2; do not use a kanji font, tapered strokes, closed-circle symbol, approximation, redesign, lighting, gradient or shadow. Keep the source's pure red and white. Place the existing SORA wordmark to its right in its existing font and color. The label is printed flat on the cover. Preserve every other part of the original square cover: subject design, positions, count, illustration composition, palette, lighting and paper grain. Full opaque square image with original clean corners and edges. No alpha, no vignette, no glow, no removed background, no extra text or subjects. Cover identity: blank-side-promise.
assets.inspection: Accepted: clear supplied red circular emblem with white open lower cutouts on upper-left white plaque; ivory cassette, cyan ribbon, peach horizon and indigo composition retained. Revised prior small and tapered-stroke logo variants.
